ns2:course.label: Leisure and Human Development
ns2:course.description: Examines changes in expressive style and behavior over the life course, and the interaction of leisure with developmental processes. Prerequisite: RST 100 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: RST 100 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
